tweets: Price oracle manipulation exploits vulnerabilities to alter contract execution logic.
This can lead to unauthorized actions, fund loss, and broader logic exploitation.
Contracts should aggregate multiple oracle and DEX sources while rejecting anomalous outliers.
Use Time-Weighted Average Prices (TWAPs) over sufficient windows and reject stale prices exceeding thresholds.
Implement fail-safe behaviors that halt sensitive operations when oracle data is suspicious or unavailable.
